summary: Searches fares across partner airlines and lets travelers complete booking and payment in a single guided flow.
Helps travelers piece together a multi-city itinerary across several airlines while keeping total fare and layover times visible throughout.
Watches a saved route and notifies the traveler when the fare drops below a price they set, without needing to check back manually.
Shows the live seat map for a booked flight and lets travelers choose or change their seat, including paid upgrade options.
Suggests alternate flights when a traveler's original booking is canceled, applying any fare difference credit automatically.
Powers hotel search and booking across the property network, holding live rate and room-type availability at checkout.
Shows a traveler the same room's rate across cancellation policies side by side so they can pick the option that fits their plans.
Lets a confirmed guest place a bid for a room upgrade ahead of check-in, which the property can accept if the upgraded room is available.
Manages a block of rooms held for a wedding or conference, letting guests book from the block using a shared code until it releases.
Processes hotel cancellations against the property's cancellation policy and issues the correct refund or credit automatically.
Combines flight, hotel, and activity confirmations into a single chronological itinerary the traveler can view in one place.
Lets a group of travelers collaborate on a shared trip board, voting on activities and splitting planning tasks before departure.
Lets a traveler drag activities and reservations onto a day-by-day calendar view of their trip, flagging scheduling overlaps.
Stores boarding passes, hotel confirmations, and rental agreements in one wallet accessible offline during the trip.
Downloads a full copy of the itinerary to the traveler's device so it remains viewable without a connection while abroad.
Shows members their current mileage balance, recent activity, and available redemption options across flights and partner offers.
Tracks a member's progress toward the next elite tier and shows exactly how many qualifying miles or segments remain.
Lets a member transfer points to a family member's account or convert them to a partner program's currency at the posted exchange rate.
Lets members redeem points for hotel stays, car rentals, or merchandise through partner brands without leaving the loyalty app.
Warns members ahead of time when a portion of their mileage balance is about to expire from inactivity, with a one-tap way to extend it.
Sends travelers a real-time notification the moment their booked flight is delayed, along with the newly estimated departure time.
Suggests the next available flight options when a traveler's original flight is canceled, ranked by shortest total delay.
Aggregates weather advisories along a traveler's route and warns them ahead of departure if conditions are likely to cause delays.
Pushes an instant alert to a traveler's phone when their departure gate changes, including walking directions to the new gate.
Walks a traveler through filing a delay or cancellation compensation claim, pre-filling flight details from their booking record.
Lets travelers compare and reserve a rental car by class and location, holding the reservation without a deposit until pickup.
Shows rental counter staff which vehicle classes are actually available at a location right now, accounting for returns still in progress.
Guides a rental agent through a photo-based vehicle inspection at pickup and return, timestamping evidence for damage disputes.
Lets a renter unlock their reserved vehicle with their phone and skip the counter entirely for eligible rental locations.
Lets a renter extend their rental period from their phone, checking vehicle availability against the next reservation before confirming.
Pulls flight, hotel, and meal charges from a traveler's corporate card directly into a draft expense report during the trip.
Flags a booking that exceeds the traveler's company travel policy limits before it's confirmed, suggesting compliant alternatives.
Calculates the correct daily per diem allowance for a trip based on destination and duration, applying it automatically to the expense report.
Routes a completed travel expense report to the traveler's manager for approval and escalates it if it sits unreviewed too long.
Matches corporate card statement lines against submitted expense reports and flags any charges still missing a report.
Lets travelers check in for their flight from their phone starting the standard window before departure and select or confirm a seat.
Generates a scannable digital boarding pass added to the traveler's mobile wallet, updating automatically if the gate or time changes.
Lets a checked-in traveler reserve a bag drop time slot at the airport to avoid waiting in a general queue during peak hours.
Lets a checked-in traveler request an open seat change at the gate and get notified the moment the request is approved.
Verifies a traveler's priority boarding or security lane eligibility at the checkpoint by scanning their digital boarding pass.
Shows a traveler their checked bag's last scanned location as it moves through sorting, loading, and arrival at the destination airport.
Lets a traveler file a delayed baggage report at the arrival airport and tracks the bag's recovery and delivery status afterward.
Schedules courier delivery of a recovered delayed bag to the traveler's hotel or home address at a time they choose.
Lets baggage service agents log a damage claim with photos and process a repair or reimbursement decision against airline policy.
Flags checked bags at risk of missing a tight connection based on the last scan time and remaining transfer window.
Gives travelers a live chat channel with a support agent who can see their full booking context without asking them to repeat it.
Escalates a complex support case from a front-line agent to a specialist team, carrying over the full case history and notes.
Lets a support agent review and process a traveler's refund request against the fare rules attached to their original booking.
Lets agents and self-service travelers search a shared knowledge base of policy answers, kept current by the support content team.
Lets a traveler request a callback at a chosen time instead of waiting on hold, queuing the request for the next available agent.
Lets a group organizer manage flight and hotel bookings for a large party under one reservation, tracking who has paid their share.
Splits the cost of a shared group booking across participants and sends each person their own payment link and due date.
Tracks passenger names, passport details, and dietary needs for a group trip, exporting the roster in the format each supplier requires.
Sends the finalized group itinerary and any last-minute changes to every participant at once, confirming who has viewed it.
Sends a group's size and dates to multiple suppliers at once and compares the negotiated group rates that come back.
Offers curated guides to neighborhoods, sights, and local tips for a chosen destination, built from traveler and editorial contributions.
Surfaces bookable local tours and activities near a traveler's hotel, filtered by date availability and traveler interests.
Surfaces limited-time destination deals in a personalized feed based on a traveler's past searches and saved destinations.
Asks a traveler a few quick questions about their travel style and suggests a shortlist of matching destinations and trip types.
Pulls together traveler reviews for a hotel or activity from multiple sources into a single summarized rating and highlight list.
